AND m.member_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{orgMemberPageDTO.memberName},'%')
AND l.id IN
#{item}
AND p.id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY m.id

SELECT l.id AS level_id, l.level_name, pds.post_id, pds.data_id, pds.data_scope, pds.data_flag FROM org_member_user_rel mur LEFT JOIN org_member_post_rel mpr ON mur.member_id = mpr.member_id LEFT JOIN org_post_data_scope pds ON mpr.post_id = pds.post_id LEFT JOIN org_level l ON mpr.level_id = l.id WHERE mur.user_id = #{userId}
